evidence.excerpt: Lalić collaborated with a regional packaging manufacturer (Ambalažna Industrija Vojvodine d.o.o.) during the STARPAK project, providing formulation testing and processing support for a prototype biodegradable tray. She spent one month in 2019 at the R&D pilot plant of a Slovenian compounding company (Polimer Sistem d.o.o., Ljubljana) to assess scale-up behaviour of TPS formulations.
